verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents offline on-device LLM chat, streaming, tool calling and structured output. Nothing in the evidence covers document ingestion, embeddings, vector search, or automatic retrieval-augmented generation over a user's own files. Offline chat and tool calling are adjacent building blocks, not the RAG capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation
